decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans W100, received 13th June 2011 and PL101, PL102, PL103, PL301, PL302, received 3rd August 2011 submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The access doorway to the premises at 124-126 Chiswick High Road  shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.

Condition : 4 - No refuse collection or deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 7.00am and 11.00pm on Mondays to Saturdays and 11.00am and 5.00pm on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 5 - The rating level of noise emitted from fixed plant on the site, shall be lower than the existing background noise level by 10dB. The noise levels shall be determined at the nearest noise sensitive locations. The measurements shall be made according to BS4142:1997
Condition : 6 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times: 10.00am - 11.00pm on Mondays to Fridays and 10.00am - 10.00pm on Saturdays.
Condition : 7 - Access to 124-126 Chiswick High Road for patrons of the restaurant shall be from the proposed front access door on Chiswick High Road only.
Condition : 8 - The refuse storage and recycling arrangements shown on the approved drawing shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 9 - Before the development is commenced, details of a sound insulation scheme between the floors of the flats and the change of use hereby approved at 124-126 Chiswick High Road shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details prior to the first occupation of the site.
description: Change of use of the ground floor and basement from A1 retail use to A3 restaurant use
